scope: Native recovery pose and weapon queries through actual World, ObScript and package/dialogue condition services
rules: IsFacingUp: eligible actor missing Spine returns1; native NiWorld R21 at+0x80 must be strictlypositive. Signedzeros andNaNsfalse. IsLeftUp remains R22 at+0x84.
IsWeaponOut: missing/Low process0, active process uses existing controller draw view; nonzero native byte115 istrue.
GetWeaponAnimType: independent of draw state, active worn nativeWEAP type0/2 ->1,1/3 ->2,5 ->3; staff4/other ->0. No wornentry or missing/Low process ->0.
Use existing native class/process, equipped-slot and winning WEAP identity. Never use projected TES3 damage/skill category or construct cold actor authority during a query.
world_regressions: Player/NPC/Creature plus Low actor, all six native weapon types, sheathed/weapon/spell draw states and empty/unworn inventory
Deliberately wrong projected TES3 weapon categories cannot change native animation family
Direct query, ObScript and dialogue CTDA agreement, including run-on-target Player and both true/false comparisons
Cold resident and unloaded actors: no custom-data/value-state creation or process promotion; unchanged combat/inventory snapshots after queries
Actual renderer physical-pose quarter rotations distinguish R21 from R12/R22, then restored animated pose; existing scoped horse fallback/LeftUp regressions retained
limits: Native oracle supplies typed actor/process/inventory fixtures; it does not prove original process promotion or inventory producer construction
Current fork process authority represents High/Low. Active weapon views must already be resident; unavailable active view is Unsupported in conditions, not a guessed weapon category
Winning native weapon type must fit one byte; unavailable native typed definitions (including unsupported generated definitions) are rejected
Renderer pose bridge retains its rigid/finite admission gate; NaN comparison semantics are covered by pure original-derived query fixtures
Raw actor model and nullable native CTDA dispatch, exact KF/slot5 playback, physical FSM/GetUp/restart, directional mastery and full normal-input S4 acceptance remain open
